meta.title: Water-ice-bearing permanently shadowed regions (PSRs), lunar south polar region
meta.source: Lemelin, M., Li, S., Mazarico, E., Siegler, M. A., Kring, D. A., Paige, D. A. (2021). Framework for coordinated efforts in the exploration of volatiles in the south polar region of the Moon. Planetary Science Journal 2, 103. doi:10.3847/PSJ/abf3c5
meta.dataset: Database of water ice-bearing permanently shaded regions in the lunar south polar region, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.4646092, CC BY 4.0
meta.ice_detection: Moon Mineralogy Mapper (M3) surface water-ice detections (Li et al. 2018, PNAS 115, 8907); m3 = number of detections inside the PSR

fields.H_*_ppm: Lunar Prospector / LEND hydrogen (ppm) as listed in the dataset
fields.T_*: annual temperature (K), Diviner; null = no data
fields.dist_m: min distance (m) to a potential landing site at slope limits 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 deg

meta.rings20: outline in south polar stereographic (R=1737.4 km), integer units of 20 m, flat [x,y,...]; simplified (Douglas-Peucker 40 m)

lcross.note: LCROSS impact site in Cabeus (9 Oct 2009); water confirmed, ~5.6 +/- 2.9 wt% (Colaprete et al. 2010, Science 330, 463)
